newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end off, technicals weak before data.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end off, technicals weak before data.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled lower on local and trade selling amid a weak technical outlook.

But volume was estimated at only 1,500 lots as players squared positions ahead of USDA's key estimate for Florida's citrus crop, to be released Friday at 0830 EDT. The estimate is the first of the season.
"Everything depends on the number. That will set the tone for the market," an analyst said.
Industry sources expect USDA to raise production from last year's crop of 203.2 million 90-lb boxes, to between 215.0 million and 225.0 million boxes.
Spot November closed 1.00 cent lower at 112.20 cents a lb after trading from 112.90 to 111.20. The back months settled 1.70 lower to 0.05 firmer.
Nearby support was pegged at 110.00 and firm resistance at 116.00 and then 119.00 for the spot contract.
